assumptions: Price not given; assumed $90 for a 'premium' product.
Gross margin not given; assumed 45% (typical for pet).
subscription: assumed 4.0 orders per customer over ~6 months.
Target CPA = 70% of max affordable CAC ($90 x 45% margin x 4.0 orders = $162.00).

pricing.rationale: Acquisition goal with no conversion history: pay per click. Max CPC = target CPA $113.40 x click-to-purchase rate (1.5%-5.0%). Clicks are observable without trusting a pixel, so both sides can verify billing.
pricing.tcpa_unlock: tCPA unlocks after conversion tracking is verified and 50 click-through conversions are recorded; until then Disco can't predict conversion rate for this brand.

budget.pacing: even daily pacing; pause a host if CPA > 2.0x target after 150 clicks

allocations.rationale: score 0.57 -> fit x1.40 on CTR/CVR; bid $4.76
score 0.31 -> fit x1.04 on CTR/CVR; bid $3.53; host sells a competing product, so it may decline (capacity discounted)

warnings: No budget given: recommending $2,930, the smallest budget that buys 300 clicks per host.
